 On: 2026-03-19
I recused myself from: Discussion
Regarding: CEO 2025-26 Performance Evaluation, year-end assessment and 2026-27 Performance Agreement
During the closed session of the board of directors meeting, I recused myself from participating in a discussion in relation to the annual assessment of my performance evaluation and the performance agreement for the next fiscal year in order to avoid a conflict of interest between my official functions and my private interest.
